title: Sing to the Lord of Harvest
description: Sing to the Lord of Harvest in Tonic Solfa to WIE LIEBLICH IST DER MAIEN: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the four verses, and a piano.
about: John S. B. Monsell published these words in the second edition of his Hymns of Love and Praise (1866). The tune WIE LIEBLICH IST DER MAIEN is by Johann Steurlein (1575).
underlay: Sing to the Lord_ of_ har-vest, Sing songs of love and praise; With joy-ful hearts_ and_ voi-ces Your al-le-lu-ias raise. By Him the roll-ing_ sea-sons In fruit-ful or_-der_ move; Sing to the Lord_ of_ har-vest, A joy-ous song of love.

lines: Sing to the Lord of harvest,
Sing songs of love and praise;
Sing to the Lord of harvest,
By Him the clouds drop fatness,
The hills leap up in gladness,
He crowns the year with goodness,
The souls He died to save.
Your hearts lay down before Him
When at His feet you fall,
And with your lives adore Him,
Who gave His life for all.
To Christ, who, when we wandered,
